mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the completed pathways to the body was most worthwhile: the head-turn example brought the sensors, eye movements and posture together in a situation I could picture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the nerve pathways was clear but felt like a routine connection; its result did not explain much beyond the item descriptions.

surprise.text: The weighted membranes respond both to gravity and to changes in straight-line motion. The paired descriptions helped me see what those situations share.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary: the item descriptions made each connection plausible, though several were predictable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter if it similarly connects a familiar experience to a body system. The final head-turn example made the assembly more interesting than the individual connections.
